subject.title: refactor: prune unsupported OPENCLAW env overrides

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally stop honoring these seven undocumented environment overrides in the next release without a deprecation window?
rationale: The audit supports treating them as unsupported, but three aliases carry credentials or ClawHub path selection and two alter visible terminal preferences, so accepting immediate upgrade behavior is an owner decision rather than a correctness question.

options.title: Accept the bounded removal
options.body: Merge after exact-head checks, relying on the retained canonical settings and `CLAWHUB_*` variables because no documented or packaged contract was found for the removed names.

options.title: Preserve a deprecation window
options.body: Retain selected user-facing aliases temporarily with explicit warnings and a named removal release, while still deleting the purely test-only controls.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded removal
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head checks, relying on the retained canonical settings and `CLAWHUB_*` variables because no documented or packaged contract was found for the removed names.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the audit and has extensive prior repository history across the affected configuration and runtime surfaces.
